read_jsonl_dataset: read a JSONL file into a HuggingFace Dataset with auto-detected features and optional cache directory
read_jsonl_with_features: read a JSONL file into a Dataset with explicitly specified column features and dtypes
read_jsonl_with_split: read a JSONL file into a Dataset with a named split for train or test partitioning
write_dataset_to_json: write a HuggingFace Dataset to JSON lines or orient-formatted JSON with optional compression
write_dataset_multiproc: write a HuggingFace Dataset to JSON using multiple processes for parallel export
